thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High 5xx rate for `inference-service` in us-west-2. Alert triggered by error_rate > 2% over 2m (rule id: infra.errors.inference.usw2). Links: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd/inference-overview

maya: I'm on call. seeing spikes in 5xx and p95 latency climbing. starting live triage.

sam: ouch. putting a quick filter on the alerts to reduce noise: temporarily silencing infra.errors.inference.usw2 for 10m while we triage. :no_entry_sign:

maya: good. rolling a canary route to model-quant2 variant to relieve CPU memory pressure. will update LB routing to shift 20% traffic.

alejandro: adding that the cache hit ratio dropped from 82% -> 41% at 13:04 UTC, might be KV cache thrash after a model rollout.

lina: customer impact check — SLO dashboard shows <1% of requests failed last 24h but region spike is ~3% for last 10m. CS flagged a high-importance customer with timeouts. tagging for follow-up.

maya: running a quick query on logs, looks like many 503s with `kv: cache miss` and `OOM` traces. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T13:02:14Z inference-01 us-west-2 ERROR request_id=abc123 status=503 msg="kv cache miss + kernel OOM"
```

sam: can you try bumping instance memory on the canary pool? i can trigger a soft restart on 2 nodes to clear KV state.

maya: doing soft restart on canary nodes now. will monitor.

docs-bot: :robot_face: Incident created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821 — title "us-west-2 inference 5xx spike". Auto-runbooks: inference-kv-cache, inference-oom.

(2m later)

maya: soft-restarts complete. p95 latency back down ~350ms (was 1.2s). 5xx rate trending to 0.9%. rolling silence expired; re-enabling alert.

alejandro: because we silenced the alert briefly we got a lot of duplicate notifications from other rules. this incident highlights alert noise: multiple rules with overlapping scopes (region, service, global). we should reduce blast radius.

sam: agreed. proposal: change infra.errors.* rule to a two-stage rule: stage1 (warn) at 1% for 5m (no page), stage2 (page) at 2% for 2m. also add a suppression window when we detect a deployment event.
lina: +1. product wants earlier heads-up but not pager noise. maybe send to #oncall for warn and only page ops if stage2 fires.

alejandro: for retros and future hunting, i propose three new dashboard panels in Grafana for the incident retro:
- Golden signal: Error rate heatmap by region/service (5m ensemble)
- Cache health: KV hit ratio time series with per-pool breakdown
- Model fallback rate & fallback latency (shows how often we auto-route to variant)
Include drilldowns: panel links to logs query, and runbook link.

sam: i'll hack a json model for panels. quick panel config idea:
```json
{\"title\":\"KV hit ratio\",\"expr\":\"sum(cache_hits)/sum(cache_lookups) by (pool)\",\"legend\":\"{{pool}}\"}
```
use metric names: `redwood.kv.hits` and `redwood.kv.lookups`.

maya: can we surface a tiny runbook step directly in the dashboard that says: 1) check cache hit ratio, 2) soft-restart canary nodes, 3) escalate to infra if OOM persists? saves clicks during paging.

alejandro: yep — Grafana supports markdown panel. We'll put a condensed runbook + links to playbooks.

lina: also ask: threshold tuning — we should avoid static thresholds across all model sizes. models with long tail latency (e.g., large context) need model-specific thresholds. add model tag to metrics?
sam: we already emit `model_name` tag but dashboards are aggregated. I'll add template variable for `model_name` and make per-model thresholds visible.

maya: creating follow-ups in INC-4821: (1) alert rule changes (stage1/stage2), (2) new dashboard panels + drilldowns, (3) add runbook markdown panel, (4) per-model threshold variable, (5) postmortem note and customer comms draft. assigning owners.

alex (edited by maya): @sam for alert rules, @alejandro for dashboard panels, @lina for customer comms, @maya for mitigation notes.

docs-bot: checklist added to INC-4821: [ ] update Prometheus rules, [ ] create Grafana panels, [ ] write postmortem, [ ] customer email draft.

lina: i can draft the customer-facing note — will include timeline and mitigation steps.

sam: pinging infra on node memory; also scheduling a \"dashboard surgery\" sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to build the panels together. invite: @eng-sre @eng-oncall @product.

maya: thanks team — seems mitigated but keeping incident open until dashboards and alert tuning are in place. i'll hand off to next oncall in 20m.

(handoff)

maya: handing off — next oncall @ryan. brief: root cause likely KV cache thrash after a model rollout causing OOMs; mitigated via soft restarts and slow traffic shift. follow-ups tracked in INC-4821.

ryan: ack, thanks. will keep an eye overnight and pick up postmortem write-up tomorrow.

alejandro: after action note: we should add a suppression annotation to deploy events in Prometheus so alerts don't page during controlled rollouts. adding to follow-ups.

lina: i added customer notes section in the ticket. we'll coordinate on the email and include the dashboard screenshots once built.

sam: copying the quick grep command that helped find OOMs:
```
rg \"kernel OOM|cache miss\" /var/log/inference/* | head -n 200
```

maya: closing loop: p95 stable, 5xx < 1% for 30m. will transition to postmortem board after next oncall confirms. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
